answer_1.quote: We extract templates from the SIMMC 2.0 dataset... generate natural sentences based on the CFGs... We recruit crowd-workers to paraphrase the modified turns.
answer_1.outputs: system utterances and user utterances (dialogue turns)

answer_2.quote: We directly compute the accuracy on whether the model can successfully predict the correct named entity as evaluation metric. Since the generation is similar to the dialog state tracking task, we also compute the joint goal accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 5% of the disambiguation turns and ask another group of crowd-workers to judge whether the modification is valid... Each turn receives two judgements... we have an 88% of agreement rate...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given guidelines to check that the modification maintains all essential information, is not similar to the original utterance, and is natural.
